answer: Every claim climbs the mirror of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the lotus re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. What survives to the wharf is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, released only after three unrelated confirmations, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
